_comment: positioning.json —— 品牌定位单一事实源
公司画像（客户确认，2026-11，《3优化.txt》定位转型）：
Affordable Overstock SUP Inventory + Mixed Model Wholesale + Flexible International Shipping
受众 = 海外小型零售商（5-20 块混批，主）+ 个人消费者（1-2 块，保留入口）。
库存来源 mixed：自有 Weihai 生产剩余 + 其他生产合作方剩余库存；发货 express + sea freight 皆有。
保留 Weihai 制造背景（2012、12,000 m²、15,000 units 年产能）做可信度，但工厂叙事不得盖过库存销售定位。
命名铁律：全站只允许一条产品线，任何位置统一措辞：
Inflatable SUP Boards（清仓语境下可写 inflatable SUP boards / SUP packages）
禁止把 RIB / Inflatable Boat / Kayak 写回任何身份表述（title / H1 / schema / 首页文案）。
禁止 Factory Direct / OEM / ODM / Custom Manufacturing 身份表述进入 storefront；
wholesale 词汇限用于小批量混批采购语境（small-business wholesale / mixed-model wholesale）。

boilerplate.short: Discount inflatable SUP boards — overstock and clearance prices, up to 60% off retail.
boilerplate.medium: Paddle Board Overstock is an international supplier of discounted inflatable paddle boards, specializing in surplus production inventory and factory clearance batches. Brand-new complete SUP packages ship worldwide at up to 60% off retail — with mixed-model wholesale for small retailers.
boilerplate.long: Paddle Board Overstock, operated by Weihai Dongjilian Co., Ltd., is an international supplier of discounted inflatable stand-up paddle boards (SUPs), specializing in surplus production inventory and factory clearance batches. Our overstock inventory comes from surplus production batches of our own Weihai manufacturing operations and selected excess inventory sourced from other production partners. Complete paddle board packages (board, pump, paddle, leash, backpack) and accessories ship worldwide at up to 60% off retail, with {{annualCapacityUnits}} units annual production capacity behind every batch, mixed-model small-business wholesale, and secure Stripe & PayPal checkout.
